notes.title: New functionalities came to consoles!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Ringmasters! [/h3]

We’re delighted to share a massive console update to boost your circus’ performance!

First tested via our Open Beta feature in January, all new features are now being implemented on Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/7eced79dab0ea175d0696fb81e36db89e7dd30f3.png[/img]

[h2]What was added?[/h2]

[h3]Randomized Starting Troup[/h3]

When starting a new game, a player's troupe will be composed randomly within predefined criteria, both in the tutorial and other modes.

[h3]Artist’s Stress Effect[/h3]

Once every encounter is finished and based on its outcome one of the performing artists has the chance to receive the ‘Stressed’ effect.
[list]
[*] ‘Stress’ makes the artist unable to participate in the show until the effect is removed.
[*] ‘Stress’ is removed from the artist once 1 encounter is completed.
[/list]
[h3]Ability to Perform Shows in 3-Star Cities[/h3]

After acquiring 3 stars in any city, each player is able to play shows again within these cities on a normal basis, including cooldown between shows. However, the amount of revenue and experience will be lower.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: New Funtionalities in Your Circus
notes.content:
[h3]Ringmasters! 

As many of you have noticed, your beloved Circus got through the refreshment process.

As we've reached the end of OPEN BETA - where you could have personally advice us on what to improve  - we implemented the new features into the main version of the game. It means that all the refreshments are now available to each of you playing The Amazing American Circus.[/h3]


[hr][/hr]

[b]What was added[/b]: 

[h2]Randomized starting troup[/h2]

When starting a new game player's troupe will be composed randomly within predefined criteria, in both tutorial and no tutorial modes.

[h2]Artist’s stress effect[/h2]

After every encounter based on the encounter's outcome, one of the performing artists has the chance to receive the ‘Stressed’ effect.
[list]

notes.title: OPEN BETA - new functionalities ahead!
notes.content:
Ringmasters of the World! 

We promised? So we will deliver brand new exciting experimental new features to your beloved Circus game are on the way! We rolled our sleeves up, counted all the juggling balls and got to work. Aaaaaand… 

*the drum roll* 
HERE IT IS! The set of new functionalities, ready to implement into the game! Well, not exactly ready, because to polish it and prepare it as satisfactory as possible, and to meet your sublime expectations, we’d like to make a small deal with you. 

[h2][u][b]BETA BRANCH[/b][/u][/h2]

To be by the book and to test all features before the final enactment, we are asking you to join our  beta available in the branch, and leave us your valuable feedback! So before we push new mechanics to public, we were sure they are what you need.

In order to change branch to Open Beta:
[olist]
[*] Right-click on the game in your Steam library.
[*] Click “Properties”.
[*] Open the “Beta” tab.
[*] Select the “Open Beta” branch.
[*] At this point the game should start updating. Good luck and have fun testing new features!
[/olist]

[h2][u][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][b]Randomized starting troup[/b][/h3]

When starting a new game player's troupe will be composed r[b]andomly within predefined criteria[/b], in both tutorial and no tutorial modes.

[h3][b]Artist’s stress effect[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/80cb856b44d219bc946c9a898d6c4137780dd650.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/642110e9e4bd93814748158c408d3266756ca9cc.png[/img]

[b]After every encounter[/b] based on the encounter's outcome one of the performing artists has the chance to receive the ‘Stressed’ effect.

‘[b]Stress[/b]’ makes the artist not able to participate in the show, until effect is not removed from the artist.

‘[b]Stress[/b]’ is removed for the artist owning the effect after 1 encounter is completed.

[h3][b]Ability to play shows in the 3 star cities[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/c35f6949dcb7ab737b19ebed8d2b6c45c87b8247.png[/img]

After acquiring 3 stars in any city, player should be able to play shows in such cities on a normal basis (including cooldown between shows), except the amount of revenue and experience given.

[h2][b]FEEDBACK[/b][/h2]

The key is to check whether the features meet your expectations or not. We’ve studied the detailed requests and analized what would be the best options to implement into the gameplay to differentiate the experience. Hence the new functionalities above.

We’re kindly asking you to join our Amazing American Circus [url=https://discord.gg/wnh3PCdqNp]DISCORD[/url] server and leave your notes in the new dedicated channel there, called: #open-beta-feedback. https://discord.gg/wnh3PCdqNp We highly encourage you to use the DISCORD way of communication, though we will check your comments here, as well.

notes.title: January Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Mesdames et Messieurs, Ladies and Gentlemen!

Beware as the new patch to your beloved The Amazing American Circus will premiere today!
The new year brings fixes to what was broken, some brand new features, and a promise of a BIG new features coming later this month.[/h3]

[h3]Fixes:

Fixed all not unlocking achievements.
Fixed wrong colors of "Blessed Be Thy Chicken" reward chicken.
Clown's card  “French Drop" now counts all cards in the Players hand correctly.
Fixed Conjoined Twins special effect not being applied on Player's troupe.[/h3]

[h3]Important! Due to an internal error, we had changed save files localization in the last patch. If you have played recently and want to keep your progress - follow the below steps. If you haven’t played before 17th December - your save files should work fine. [/h3]

Locate your save files in C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\LocalLow\Klabater\The Amazing American Circus
Locate files with .dat extension (save0.dat, save1.dat, save2.dat)
Select and move those files to the ‘Saves’ folder. (C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\LocalLow\Klabater\The Amazing American Circus\Saves)
Make sure that the ‘Saves’ folder contains fogOfWarX.png files. 

[h3]New features:
Adjustable speed of animation[/h3]

You can now adjust the speed of animations played when casting cards and finales. We received many requests to add this feature to make The Amazing American Circus gameplay faster and smoother, and now we are delighted to confirm - we did it! You can access this feature in the game settings menu and use a  toolbar “Performance speed” to control animation speed, increasing them by 100% to 200%. The speed can be adjusted in any way anytime during the game.

[h3]More new features coming! [/h3]

The below features are currently “work-in-progress.” However, we expect to make them available as a beta branch to You all for testing still in January. We deliver them in late January or early February if met with positive feedback, so stay tuned for the following announcement coming ETA mid-January.

[h3]Randomized starting troupe[/h3]

When starting a new game, your troupe of artists will be composed randomly within predefined criteria. This will allow more fantastic replayability and encourage players to experiment with a wider choice of artists.

[h3]Artist’s stress effect[/h3]

After every given show based on the show outcome, one of the performing artists can receive the ‘Stressed’ effect. ‘Stress’ will make the artist unable to participate in the next show until the effect is not removed/ cured. The main goal of the feature is to encourage the rotation of the troupe members between the shows.

[h3]Perform Shows in the cities (endlessly)[/h3]

After performing max 3 stars in any city, You still would be able to perform there regularly (including cooldown between shows).

[h3]Steam Cloud Saves[/h3]

Self-explanatory, support of Steam Cloud Saves will be added for greater comfort.

notes.title: The Amazing Christmas Patch!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Ringmasters all over the world! 

It is not by chance we’re greeting you this way today. We’re coming to you with a bunch of really good news - all related to what’s going to change in the Circus. Frankly saying, even we are impressed that all these things could have been synchronized into one big patch. And just like Santa coming to all good children, quickly and mysteriously, we’re gonna give you a present, in a few places at the same moment. [/h3]

[h2]But what do we mean by that?[/h2]

Well, the incoming patch is fixing many bugs. According to your precious reports, many of them were localization-related, and a few of them were simply about the wrong text in the wrong places or general lack of dialogues. So now, when you decide to change the language during your gameplay, you will not encounter any localization snags. You can find the full list of patch notes below.

[h2]And what’s the most important gift in The Amazing American Santa’s sack this Christmas?[/h2]

TRADING CARDS! Starting today, you will have a chance to gather not only the incredible troupe of artists in the game but also you will build your unique Steam deck with those special trading cards. Each of them represents one artist that you encounter during your travel throughout America. 

The aim is to become The Greatest Showman on Earth, that’s for sure. But nothing stands in the way to obtain some exclusive badges and take part in the Steam Card Exchange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/a9384022c62d4f2c1ec71384f25abd82182142df.png[/img]

[h3]PATCH NOTES:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Fixed character image dialogue visibility in the quest  "By Flood and by Fire".
[*] Fixed character image and dialogue visibility in quest “Investor’s Quarrel”.
[*] Fixed the VO of Beggar in Topeka.
[*] CONTINUE button is replaced with LOAD GAME.
[*] When the cards are drawn they are no longer visible horizontally.
[*] The audience descriptions in the journal appear in the correct language after going to the menu.
[*] Max Fame Star indicator is now showing the correct number in every region.
[*] You can now see the Wagon tutorials in quest cities.
[*] Fixed bug with achievements: "Making it hard on yourself" and "Last Man Standing"
[/list]

Christmas time is coming and you gave us plenty of feedback on what's to fix. In return, we are happy to give you this patch. As always, we are counting on your flowing comments on whether everything works top-notch here!

notes.title: THE AMAZING AMERICAN CIRCUS GAINS FULL PAD CONTROLLER SUPPORT
notes.content:
Salute Ringmasters! 

[h2]Today we have a decent piece of news for you, regarding the controls and UI in our game. [/h2]

Along with this patch, we’re adding full pad controller support into the PC version of The Amazing American Circus. It means if you’ll ever want to experience the good ol’ circus adventure using your favorite controller, then the opportunity just arose! 

Additionally, while switching from keyboard to pad, the whole in-game interface will change and reflect the ‘console’ approach. So, from now on, whatever you choose, be it keyboard and mouse or pad/controller, you’ll meet no obstacles while managing your camp, because the support of Unity Universal Controller is on the flight. 

[h3]So briefly, what's been added: [/h3]
- Main (Camp) UI adjusted
- Changed the way the information about character buffs/effects is displayed (you can hover over characters/enemies to get a summary of the effects)
- Added controller support


We do hope that those changes will make your gameplay more pleasant.

notes.title: Step into the Ring on September 16th!
notes.content:
[h2]Ladies and gentlemen,

Well, it’s TOMORROW!!! We just can’t believe it! The Amazing American Circus is on the final stretch to its premiere. [/h2]

After wowing crowds at Gamescom in IGN’s Awesome Indies Showcase, getting a shout-out from Major Nelson, and piquing the interest of the American Youth Circus Organization - we are thrilled to be sending our quirky deck builder, The Amazing American Circus into town tomorrow - on September 16th!

And here’s the new trailer! Share if you like it!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sF7fUiVhqPQ

You all know that already, but please let us remind you of the core of the game: The Amazing American Circus blends a Slay the Spire-style card game with tycoon and simulation mechanics, meaning that strategic thinking and careful resource management are essential to your success in becoming America’s greatest showman. Manage your entire camp, put on performances, and expand your circus.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/dfc3dc290fd76ebd1c519f2a6eeb562b7a492f05.gif[/img]


On the launch day, you will be able not only to get the basic game. There will be a special Ringmaster’s edition containing additional content available for all of you, interested in enriching your circus impression (please mind, the direct link will be available for the premiere!):
 
[list]
[*] The official Cookbook
[*] The official lore book
[*] A set of wallpapers
[*] A digital map of the game
[*] A circus-inspired Black Peter card set (ready to be printed!)
[*] Video and graphic materials
[/list]
and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1641610/The_Amazing_American_Circus__The_Circus_Symphony/][b]The Circus Symphony[/b][/url] - The full 60 min long soundtrack composed and produced by Patryk Scelina featuring Alina Lesnik’s theme song “Where the Wind may Blow” - the official soundtrack to your circus’ quirky escapades across America!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/565b5a52d30f6bbca3046facdbc1af0b2ec350b7.jpg[/img]

[h3]The game will be available at the price of 19,99 EUR /USD.
But to boost your excitement even more, we have a nice surprise for you![/h3]

Starting within the day of the premiere, there will be a launch week discount, a special promo on the game - a 10% off on The Amazing American Circus.

notes.title: Graphical Update and... more!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Game development is a complex process, full of ever-changing design ideas, tweaking, testing, and improving. Recently we’ve sat down and redesigned one of the main sights you’ll see on your screens - the stage where your performers face the audience (otherwise known as: the battle arena). 

Up until now the artists were facing left, towards the audience. It was a satisfying sight - the opponents are on the left and our artists on the right have to avoid their attacks. However, recently we’ve decided to flip it and place the audience on the right and our performers on the left. It’s different, but we like it:) This change creates a familiar vibe and feeling well-known from games since the first Mario - the main hero progresses moving in the right (literally) direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/a8be8826e494c898f18446d8618f720c035b4a21.png[/img]
Of course, in our game, the characters don’t move physically. However, the new angle feels more intuitive, and it’s a design choice similar to those in some other card games and roguelikes.

We’re pretty satisfied with this decision and we really hope you, too, will like this - again, literally - new direction we’ve chosen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/2b6f8a0c2fc0ce865026769b9689379c3f3ca904.png[/img]
Hope you like it!

AND LAST BUT NOT LEAST, there's a crowdfunding campaign starting next week, please click "Notify me on launch" button in the link below:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/klabater/the-amazing-american-circus

Also, please expect more news about the upcoming Steam Winter Festival in the upcoming days. We plan to present you with a DEMO OF THE GAME!!!:)

notes.title: DEV BLOG #7
DEV BLOG #3
notes.content:
American history is all about being in constant motion, being on the road...

In the early 19th Century, the United States was a new, developing country with settlers steadily pushing the American frontier… The US history is full of stories related to iconic trails and roads people had to follow to pursue happiness, fortune, or whatever dream they had. Sometimes they just run from their past. We all heard about The Pony Express Trail, where young men on horseback once carried the nation’s mail across the country from 1860-1861. Later, those ‘trails’ took the form of iconic routes like the legendary Road 66, glorified in countless songs, books, and movies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/cb4a90fc55e311651e7281934e9b32f6dd9b70cf.png[/img]

To reach their public at the time, Circus showmen had little choice but to travel light and fast. In [i][b]The Amazing American Circus[/b][/i], you will visit legendary places and meet real historical characters being a part of the American circus heritage. You will plan your trip and adapt your artistic offer to different groups of spectators in a constant struggle to provide hard-working Americans with the entertainment they deserve! In a way, [i][b]The Amazing American Circus[/b][/i] is a gaming answer to the classic ‘road movies’ genre. Emerge from the South West and reach the progressive North East while seeking fame, glory, and fortune! What’s more, ‘American’ than that?

In [i][b]The Amazing American Circus[/b][/i], the game map will is e divided into 4 regions. Northeast and West being the permanent element of the game’s walkthrough, and Midwest and South being optional routes to take. -You will choose which direction he or she wants to follow during narrative events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/ae28d4bb95c3c01ccae6cd1a765c7d36e5f71a50.png[/img]

Each region will bring a unique value and vibe both gameplay-wise and in the narrative:

[list]
[*] [b]West[/b] will be ‘Wild’ indeed with a narrative focus on Native Americans’ mythology and system of beliefs. West part of the USA was the last to be fully colonized and a very tough turf for Circus performers as the audience here will be demanding and often unforgiving. To make things even worse, you will start there! 
[*] You will immediately notice that you have entered [b]the Midwest[/b] thanks to the lower temperatures and lots of weird-looking trappers all around you;). You will also encounter miners, tough folk, and even a stricter type of audience. Entertain them, and you can call yourself a Circus pro!
[*] [b]South[/b] is all about folklore, voodoo, and swamps. Expect the unexpected here. Not everything you see here is real!
[*] [b]Northeast[/b] - New England and neighboring territories. In theory, this is a modern America you want to be a part of, with a stylish audience spending heck of a lot of money! But in reality? It is a brutal battleground between the key Circus players and a place where the final Circus fight with P.T Barnum himself awaits you…
[/list]

Initially, the US map is covered by a ‘fog of war’ and, besides the narrative events and milestones, you are relatively free to choose your path. Your main goal is to give performances in various towns, but you may perform a lot of other activities on the map. The type of settlement will somewhat indicate what kind of action or adventure may await you there. As for the types of settlements, we distinguish the following:

[list]
[*] Small Town
[*] Farming Village 
[*] Mining Settlement  
[*] Modern industrial City 
[*] State Capitals
[*] Military Camps
[*] Indian Reservations
[/list]
Each type of settlement will also feature different crowds. It does not mean that you will only meet miner folk in mining settlements, but you may, of course, expect to encounter miners while visiting the mine:) 

Before you hit the road, you need to choose the desired destination and the type of food resources for the planned trip (we will tell you more about Food in one of the upcoming blogs). What is essential, you may assign specific types of food to individual artists to ensure they gain definite perks, which add some depth into planning and tactics. What’s more, some narrative events may affect your trip’s speed, so it is wise to gather more supplies as it may turn out that you need more Food to reach the selected destination. If you ignore the supply chain’s preparation, you can still travel, but your Artists will suffer from many negative perks and debuff effects… 

During your travels on the map screen, you will notice time passing by, symbolized by a Circus wagon moving on an animated background. If you have played Banner Saga, you probably remember the caravan traveling through the land. It looks pretty similar in The Amazing American Circus. 

On this screen, it is also possible to activate random narrative events. You may meet some strangers or even hire new performers! You may also chat with the so-called legendary artists employed in your troupe during your adventures. Some of them will have something exciting or useful to say in certain regions. 

So, while [b][i]The Amazing American Circus[/i][/b] is mostly a strategy, simulation, and a card game, this ‘road movie’ feeling is heavily present in the gameplay’s backbone. We do hope you will enjoy traveling across weird America!

notes.title: DEV BLOG #2
notes.content:
Welcome to the second episode of [i]The Amazing American Circus[/i] dev blog! Today we would like to shed more light on the ‘fighting’ mechanics featured in our game along with general info about the audience you may encounter during your travel. 

Important note, since our game does not include any real and brutal encounters, by ‘fight’ we mean your circus show! Who is the enemy then? 

Here’s the first catch; your biggest enemy is your audience... Sounds strange? Not necessary, if you think of the crowds visiting circuses and theatres back in the 19th and early 20th centuries:) In those days, Circus was one of the not-so-many entertainment choices, and it attracted a somewhat different audience than today. There are even historical reports of violent behavior among the public during the shows. We do not include any of these events in the game yet (maybe we will!), but the whole idea of the audience being your enemy (isn’t that SO cool, punk rock and all?) seemed charming, and we decided to make it an essential part of the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/ae7fc381e23a87163a917c2822add0feae73bafc.jpg[/img]

In [i]The Amazing American Circus[/i], you will visit varied locations, be it large towns or small, provincial countrysides. You will deliver your show to both aristocrats and simple folk, among them rowdy workers or bored troublemakers. And who you will meet during each performance, will heavily affect your gameplay options. 

[b]Your worst fear is the audience's indifference. Your best weapon is a dazzling amusement. Your artists are your army. [/b]

And now for the ‘fighting’ basics (We will discuss further details in upcoming episodes of our dev blog):

Since [i]The Amazing American Circus[/i] is, above all else, a card game in a similar fashion to, let’s say, Slay the Spire, ‘fighting’ your Audience is based on card battling mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/fd04a2abead715146aced0ae2969127dcda0f856.gif[/img]

At the beginning of each show/encounter, the player chooses five cards from the previously acquired deck (you gather cards through attending narrative events, exploring the map, and delivering outstanding performances). We call it the [b]‘Hand’ deck[/b], these five cards will be the opening of the ‘fight’. What’s more, five doesn’t have to be necessary for the final number in every encounter. Some factors may affect it, like the following:

[list]
[*] previous choices and events
[*] buffs and debuffs
[*] active perks 
[*] finisher’s effects
[*] chosen performers’ unique abilities
[*] Results related to the dishes served in your Circus Camp
[/list]
Along with the ‘Hand’ deck comes a refill of the[b] ‘Charisma’[/b] meter required to play the selected cards and in many ways affecting the whole encounter. This factor may also be subject to some changes and positive/negative effects influencing your show. 

As a player, you decide which cards you want to play and when. You just chose the card, drag & drop it on a selected Audience member (each having their own abilities and pers as well, so choose wisely!). You may also play the ‘neutral’ card by dragging and dropping it in the middle of the screen with no particular Spectators or Artist in mind. Neutral cards usually have a sweeping effect on the show. Before you choose any of the cards, you may, of course, check their impacts, and as we do have around 170 cards in the game, there’’s a lot of planning and checking waiting for you here;) After you play each card, it, of course, lands in the pile of ‘used’ cards.  

It’s too early to reveal full details but not every card can be played every time. Sometimes you need to fill the Charisma meter or pay a special cost for playing individual cards. When you use all the cards, your turn is over. 

Most of the cards in your deck are related to certain artists you invite to your troupe. So, the more artist you hire, the more choices you have. Not only you may select a specific set of performers before each show (it is a significant choice related to the type of the Audience you are about to encounter), but you may also choose between cards linked to them. 

So, overall, there is a considerable strategy and tactics field for correct planning and executing. [b]Each artist has five cards at his disposal[/b], i.e. concrete acrobatic tricks or illusionist hoaxes, etc. And, as we choose three artists for each show, [b]that gives the player 15 cards to play[/b]. 

At the beginning of each turn, the player draws more cards from the overall Deck chosen for individual encounters, and so it goes until the final of the given show. If you don’t have enough cards at your disposal (i.e., you lost some due to the enemy’s buff), the game will randomly draw cards from your used cards pile. But, hold on, this not goes without penalty. Drawing cards from the used cards pile may cost your performers additional stress and affect their statistics.

So, these are, already pretty complicated, basics. We will share more details in upcoming episodes of our dev blog. Make sure you shoot us in the comments should you have any questions!

notes.title: The Amazing American Circus Announced!
notes.content:
Klabater, a developer of Crossroads Inn, and Juggler Games - studio behind My Memory of Us, have announced their new collaborative production - The Amazing American Circus. The game is set to be released on PC and consoles in 2021.

Watch the announcement teaser: https://youtu.be/JYf6bnOrLI8

The Amazing American Circus is a unique blend of a card game, tycoon, and an adventure game. Build a wandering circus, collect a strong deck of cards, gather a fantastic troupe of artists and performers, and travel across the 19th century United States! Dare to challenge the legendary P.T. Barnum and make your enterprise the most incredible show of America!

"At Klabater, we are fascinated by history. We develop and publish narrative-driven games that depict vital and thought-provoking moments in life. We are currently focusing on the turbulent times of the late 19th and early 20th centuries. The Amazing American Circus marks a bold third chapter in our ambitious project of games that combine captivating narratives from that era with eye-catching art and compelling gameplay. The best-selling games We. The Revolution and Help Will Come Tomorrow were the first two chapters." - Said Michal Gembicki, CEO at Klabater.

[b]Your worst fear is the audience's indifference. Your best weapon is a dazzling amusement. Your artists are your army. Behold, the circus came to town![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/64e4c56f8cc0dbfabb10b4cce034ac2d0e8c81de.jpg[/img]

The Amazing American Circus tells the story of the most iconic entertainment in American history. The USA, during the Gilded Age, is a turbulent place with serious social problems and rapid economic growth with railroads and industrialization leading the way. On the East Coast, a modern metropolis springs up, while in the west, cowboys and robber barons and farmers battle for a piece of the new American dream… A new era is coming, and it may be the right moment for a traveling circus to flourish. 

“The Amazing American Circus blends our unique artistic vision with meticulous gameplay design.” said Lukasz Janczuk from Juggler Games. “My Memory of Us was an important story of two kids escaping an oppressive system through varied logical puzzles. With The Amazing American Circus we want to offer an exotic world of pioneer entertainers, alongside a challenging card game and enjoyable management system.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997341/4ba37c5642e8041cfc022074d0856fbcf14dd930.jpg[/img]

You take the role of an impoverished owner of a traveling Circus. Through your personal and multithreaded story, The Amazing American Circus reveals mysteries behind a uniquely American form of entertainment.
Deliver a perfect show in a special card duel between you and the audience. Boredom is your enemy, and your performances and tricks are your best weapons. Choose your cards wisely and try to figure out the mood of the crowd. As a traveling Circus owner, you need to look for new troupe members. During your travels, you will try to gather an exotic crew of performers, but can you deliver the best shows, win the audience’s approval, or will you fail? 

A unique story filled with love affairs, hateful enemies, and magnificent shows with challenging audiences and quests, all of this wrapped up in a writing style that resembles the dime novels from the turn of the 20th century - that's what The Amazing American Circus offers. 

What The Amazing American Circus has to offer?
[list]
[*] Save a run-down circus, gather a troupe of performers, and dare to defy the greatest showman on earth - P.T Barnum himself.
[*] Enjoy an original and challenging card game. You will battle against your greatest enemies, audience boredom, and stagnation.
[*] Gather a group of extraordinary artists and twisted individuals, each with their own story to tell, and journey across the 19th century United States.
[*] Indulge in a story set in the turbulent times of the Industrial Revolution and the dusk of the Wild West era, and dive into the beautiful and grim world of the American folklore
[*] 100+ real historical and legendary characters from the verge of the 19th and 20th century to encounter, such as John D. Rockefeller, Susan B. Anthony, or Nikola Tesla.
[*] Experience an epic soundtrack inspired by classical circus music
[/list]
The Amazing American Circus will be released in 2021. Please visit the [url=https://www.facebook.com/AACircusGame]Facebook page[/url] for more information.
